headline: Dalmia Bharat Approves ₹700 Crore Share Buyback at ₹1,850 per Share
summary: Indian cement producer Dalmia Bharat approved buying back up to 37.83 lakh equity shares, or 2.02% of paid-up capital, for up to ₹700 crore.
why: Dalmia Bharat is one of India's major cement producers, benefiting from ongoing domestic infrastructure and construction demand.

impacts.name: Dalmia Bharat
impacts.why: The board authorized a ₹700 crore equity buyback at a premium price.
